findings.reason: the §11 build node's done-when would name the shared resolver in `lane.py` (owner of `write_lane_document`) as the path source instead of adding a fifth derivation.
findings.text: §11 resolves the lane document with `SiteConfig.from_env().endpoint_document.with_name(LANE_FILENAME)`, the fifth inline spelling of the same derivation (`cli.py:1679,3433,3515,3571` already carry it four times); the section should extend one resolver so a lane document that moves is spelled in one place

findings.reason: the §11 build node should read the histogram through `engine_metrics`'s owner (or add the advance/median there) so the schema has one definition and a change to `as_dict` cannot silently break the live block.
findings.text: §11 computes the median time to first token from the recorded `engine.histograms` dict, re-deriving the serialized histogram shape (`buckets`/`count`/`sum`) that `imas_ambix/agent/engine_metrics.py:455` `Histogram`/`as_dict` already owns; two modules now know one schema with no shared definition

findings.reason: with cli_options at 0 this section must say in its own text what the new command retires, or that it retires nothing and why that is unavoidable.
findings.text: §8's retention rules introduce `agent retire-raw` with an `--apply` flag (cli.py:2956,2977) and the section text neither names anything it retires or merges nor states why nothing can be, while §5 (removes the SLURM generator's `--submit`/`--dry-run`) and §11 (states why `--live` cannot merge) both account for their surface

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §11's `imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py` is one module (526 lines) hiding lane-document copy and receipt-tail differencing behind `lane_block`/`live_block`/`live_panel`; it is not a spread of wrappers over one machinery, and its "never opens the index" property is stated and testable.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: two findings — §11 adds a fifth inline spelling of the lane-document path rather than naming one resolver, and `live_panel` re-derives the serialized engine-histogram schema that `engine_metrics.Histogram` owns.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §8 adds a CLI command and option without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be, while §5 and §11 both account for their additions.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the sections name the mechanisms they extend and I confirmed them in code: `counter_run_continues` shared by compactor and query (§8), `availability_percent`/`classify_reading` imported from `imas_ambix/agent/lane.py` by `live_panel.py` (§11, §14), `tier_paths` from `serving_receipts`, and the single price owner `provider_prices.table_path` resolved through `SiteConfig` with `watch.DEFAULT_PRICE_PATH` gone (§12).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the two wrappers present are each justified in text: §11's `--live` states why it cannot merge into `--json` (it must skip the index), and §10's JSON-document consumption states why gpu-watch must not import the package (it is a standalone dotfiles script).
